causalCorrection.finding: The earlier directed inspection incorrectly treated purchase returns as an unresolved DevolucionCompra gap.
causalCorrection.resolution: Live repo inspection confirms DevolucionProveedor, DevolucionProveedorDetalle and DevolucionesProveedorController are canonical existing sources linked to supplier, purchase order, receipt and supplier invoice. The preflight artifact was corrected before this acceptance.

findings: Supplier and historical ordered-price dimensions are source-backed by OrdenCompra and OrdenCompraDetalle.
Receipt quantities, states, timestamps and cost snapshots are source-backed by RecepcionCompra and RecepcionCompraDetalle.
Supplier invoice quantities and price snapshots are source-backed by FacturaProveedor and FacturaProveedorDetalle.
Real purchase returns are source-backed by DevolucionProveedor/Detalle and must not be replaced by order cancellation or receipt annulment.
Variation and compliance have source-backed inputs but still require explicit N5.5.B contract semantics; no formula is invented in PRE.
No schema/data/Production/main/secrets/PR#2 merge change is required by N5.5.A.
